## Overview

**jsh** (Joseph's Shell) is a Unix shell written in Rust that provides:

- **Full Bash/ZSH compatibility** - existing scripts run unchanged
- **Enhanced syntax** - match expressions, try/catch, named parameters
- **Fish support** - set, string, math, abbreviations
- **POSIX compliance** - sh/dash/ash compatible
- **Built-in git** - git_branch, git_status, git_prompt

### Technical Details

- **Language**: Rust (Edition 2024)
- **Version**: 0.1.0
- **License**: MIT OR Apache-2.0
- **Author**: Joseph R. Quinn
- **Minimum Rust**: 1.85
- **Platforms**: Linux, macOS, BSD, Unix-like systems

---

## Compatibility

### Bash Compatibility (Full)

| Feature | Syntax | Status |
|---------|--------|--------|
| If statements | `if [ cond ]; then ... fi` | ✅ |
| Elif/else | `elif [ cond ]; then ... else ...` | ✅ |
| For loops | `for x in list; do ... done` | ✅ |
| C-style for | `for ((i=0; i<10; i++)); do ... done` | ✅ |
| While loops | `while [ cond ]; do ... done` | ✅ |
| Until loops | `until [ cond ]; do ... done` | ✅ |
| Case statements | `case $x in pattern) ... ;; esac` | ✅ |
| Select | `select x in list; do ... done` | ✅ |
| Functions | `function name { }` or `name() { }` | ✅ |
| Pipes | `cmd1 | cmd2 | cmd3` | ✅ |
| Redirections | `>`, `>>`, `<`, `2>`, `2>&1`, `&>` | ✅ |
| Here documents | `<<EOF ... EOF` | ✅ |
| Here strings | `<<<string` | ✅ |
| Command subst | `$(cmd)` or `` `cmd` `` | ✅ |
| Process subst | `<(cmd)` and `>(cmd)` | ✅ |
| Arithmetic | `$((expr))` | ✅ |
| Arrays | `arr=(a b c)`, `${arr[0]}` | ✅ |
| Associative | `declare -A map; map[key]=val` | ✅ |
| Globs | `*.txt`, `file?`, `[abc]*`, `**/*.rs` | ✅ |
| Brace expansion | `{a,b,c}`, `{1..10}` | ✅ |
| Tilde expansion | `~`, `~user` | ✅ |
| Background | `cmd &` | ✅ |
| Logical ops | `&&`, `||`, `!` | ✅ |
| Subshells | `(cmd1; cmd2)` | ✅ |
| Grouping | `{ cmd1; cmd2; }` | ✅ |

### ZSH Compatibility (Full)

All Bash features plus:

| Feature | Syntax | Status |
|---------|--------|--------|
| Prompt escapes | `%n`, `%m`, `%~`, `%c`, `%T` | ✅ |
| Prompt colors | `%F{color}text%f`, `%K{bg}%k` | ✅ |
| Prompt conditionals | `%(?.true.false)` | ✅ |
| Bold/effects | `%B...%b`, `%U...%u` | ✅ |
| oh-my-zsh themes | Theme format compatibility | ✅ |
| git_prompt_info | `$(git_prompt_info)` | ✅ |

### Fish Compatibility (Partial)

| Feature | Status | Notes |
|---------|--------|-------|
| `set var value` | ✅ | Variable assignment |
| `set -x var value` | ✅ | Export variable |
| `set -e var` | ✅ | Erase variable |
| `set -q var` | ✅ | Query (check if set) |
| `set -g var value` | ✅ | Global scope |
| `string length` | ✅ | String length |
| `string upper/lower` | ✅ | Case conversion |
| `string split` | ✅ | Split string |
| `string join` | ✅ | Join strings |
| `string replace` | ✅ | Replace substring |
| `string match` | ✅ | Pattern matching |
| `string sub` | ✅ | Substring |
| `math expr` | ✅ | Arithmetic |
| `contains item list` | ✅ | List membership |
| `status is-interactive` | ✅ | Check interactive |
| `status is-login` | ✅ | Check login shell |
| `functions` | ✅ | List functions |
| `functions -q name` | ✅ | Query function |
| `functions -e name` | ✅ | Erase function |
| `abbr --add` | ✅ | Add abbreviation |
| `abbr --list` | ✅ | List abbreviations |
| `abbr --erase` | ✅ | Remove abbreviation |
| `switch/case/end` | ✅ | Fish-style switch |
| `begin/end` | ✅ | Block grouping |
| `and`, `or`, `not` | ✅ | Logical operators |
| Fish autoloading | ❌ | Not supported |
| Fish completions | ❌ | Not supported |
| `function --argument-names` | ❌ | Use jsh named params |

### POSIX Compatibility (Full)

| Feature | Status |
|---------|--------|
| `set -e` (errexit) | ✅ |
| `set -u` (nounset) | ✅ |
| `set -x` (xtrace) | ✅ |
| `set -n` (noexec) | ✅ |
| `set -a` (allexport) | ✅ |
| `set -C` (noclobber) | ✅ |
| `set -b` (notify) | ✅ |
| `set -f` (noglob) | ✅ |
| `set -o optname` | ✅ |
| `set +o optname` | ✅ |
| `set --` | ✅ |
| `test` / `[` | ✅ |
| `.` (source) | ✅ |
| `trap` | ✅ |
| `readonly` | ✅ |
| `local` | ✅ |
| `getopts` | ✅ |

## Installation

### From Source (Recommended)

```bash
# Clone repository
git clone https://github.com/quinnjr/jsh.git
cd jsh

# Build release binary
cargo build --release

# Install to ~/.cargo/bin
cargo install --path .

# Or copy manually
sudo cp target/release/jsh /usr/local/bin/
```

### Pre-built Packages

#### Debian/Ubuntu

```bash
wget https://github.com/quinnjr/jsh/releases/latest/download/jsh_0.1.0_amd64.deb
sudo apt install ./jsh_0.1.0_amd64.deb
```

#### Fedora/RHEL/CentOS

```bash
wget https://github.com/quinnjr/jsh/releases/latest/download/jsh-0.1.0-1.x86_64.rpm
sudo dnf install ./jsh-0.1.0-1.x86_64.rpm
```

#### Arch Linux

```bash
# From AUR
yay -S jsh

# Or manually
git clone https://github.com/quinnjr/jsh.git
cd jsh/packaging
makepkg -si
```

### Set as Default Shell

```bash
# Add to system shells
echo /usr/local/bin/jsh | sudo tee -a /etc/shells

# Change your shell
chsh -s /usr/local/bin/jsh
```

---

## Command Line Usage

```
USAGE:
    jsh [OPTIONS] [SCRIPT] [ARGS...]

OPTIONS:
    -c COMMAND      Execute COMMAND string and exit
    -s              Read commands from standard input
    -i              Force interactive mode
    -l, --login     Start as a login shell
    -h, --help      Print help information
    -V, --version   Print version information

EXAMPLES:
    jsh                         # Interactive shell
    jsh script.sh               # Run script
    jsh script.sh arg1 arg2     # Run script with arguments
    jsh -c 'echo hello'         # Execute command
    echo 'echo hi' | jsh -s     # Read from stdin
    jsh -l                      # Login shell
```

---

## Syntax Reference

### Comments

```bash
# This is a comment
echo "hello"  # Inline comment
```

### Variables

```bash
# Assignment (no spaces around =)
name="value"
name=value

# Export to environment
export PATH="/usr/local/bin:$PATH"

# Local (function scope)
local var="value"

# Readonly
readonly CONST="immutable"

# jsh: let and const
let mutable = "can change"
const IMMUTABLE = "cannot change"
```

### Quoting

```bash
# Single quotes - literal (no expansion)
echo 'Hello $name'  # Output: Hello $name

# Double quotes - allows expansion
echo "Hello $name"  # Output: Hello World

# Escape characters
echo "Line1\nLine2"
echo $'Line1\nLine2'  # ANSI-C quoting

# No quotes - word splitting and glob expansion
echo *.txt
```

### Command Separators

```bash
# Semicolon - sequential
cmd1; cmd2; cmd3

# Newline - sequential
cmd1
cmd2

# && - AND (run next if previous succeeds)
cmd1 && cmd2

# || - OR (run next if previous fails)
cmd1 || cmd2

# & - background
cmd1 &

# | - pipe
cmd1 | cmd2
```

### Redirections

```bash
# Output
cmd > file          # Overwrite
cmd >> file         # Append
cmd 2> file         # Stderr
cmd &> file         # Both stdout and stderr
cmd > file 2>&1     # Both (alternative)

# Input
cmd < file          # From file
cmd <<EOF           # Here document
line1
line2
EOF
cmd <<<string       # Here string

# File descriptors
exec 3> file        # Open fd 3 for writing
echo "text" >&3     # Write to fd 3
exec 3>&-           # Close fd 3
```

---

## Built-in Commands

### Navigation Commands

#### cd - Change Directory

```bash
cd                  # Go to $HOME
cd /path/to/dir     # Go to directory
cd -                # Go to $OLDPWD
cd ~                # Go to $HOME
cd ~user            # Go to user's home
cd ..               # Go to parent
```

#### pwd - Print Working Directory

```bash
pwd                 # Print current directory
pwd -P              # Physical path (resolve symlinks)
pwd -L              # Logical path (default)
```

#### pushd/popd/dirs - Directory Stack

```bash
pushd /path         # Push dir and cd
popd                # Pop dir and cd
dirs                # List stack
dirs -c             # Clear stack
```

### Variable Commands

#### export - Export Variables

```bash
export VAR="value"  # Export with value
export VAR          # Export existing
export -n VAR       # Unexport
export -p           # Print all exports
```

#### set - Shell Options and Parameters

```bash
set -e              # Exit on error
set -u              # Error on unset vars
set -x              # Print commands
set -o errexit      # Same as -e
set +e              # Disable -e
set -- a b c        # Set positional params
set                 # Print all variables

# Fish-style (when used with set command)
set name value      # Set variable
set -x name value   # Export
set -e name         # Erase
set -q name         # Query
```

#### local/readonly/declare

```bash
local var="value"               # Function-local
readonly CONST="immutable"      # Read-only
declare var="value"             # Declare variable
declare -x var="value"          # Declare and export
declare -r var="value"          # Declare readonly
declare -i var=42               # Integer
declare -a arr=(1 2 3)          # Array
declare -A map=([k]=v)          # Associative array
```

### Control Flow Commands

#### exit/return

```bash
exit                # Exit with last status
exit 0              # Exit success
exit 1              # Exit failure
return              # Return from function
return 0            # Return success
return 1            # Return failure
```

#### true/false/:

```bash
true                # Return 0
false               # Return 1
:                   # No-op, return 0
```

### Job Control

#### jobs/fg/bg/wait

```bash
jobs                # List jobs
jobs -l             # With PIDs
fg                  # Foreground last job
fg %1               # Foreground job 1
bg                  # Background last job
bg %1               # Background job 1
wait                # Wait for all jobs
wait $pid           # Wait for specific PID
wait %1             # Wait for job 1
```

### Source and Eval

#### source/.

```bash
source script.sh    # Execute in current shell
. script.sh         # Same as source
source script.sh arg1 arg2  # With arguments
```

#### eval

```bash
eval "echo hello"   # Evaluate string
cmd="ls -la"
eval "$cmd"         # Execute variable content
```

#### exec

```bash
exec /bin/bash      # Replace shell
exec 3> file        # Open file descriptor
exec 3>&-           # Close file descriptor
```

### Test Commands

#### test/[

```bash
test -f file        # File exists and is regular
test -d dir         # Directory exists
test -e path        # Path exists
test -r file        # Readable
test -w file        # Writable
test -x file        # Executable
test -s file        # Non-empty file
test -z "$str"      # String is empty
test -n "$str"      # String is non-empty
test "$a" = "$b"    # Strings equal
test "$a" != "$b"   # Strings not equal
test $n -eq $m      # Numeric equal
test $n -ne $m      # Not equal
test $n -lt $m      # Less than
test $n -le $m      # Less or equal
test $n -gt $m      # Greater than
test $n -ge $m      # Greater or equal
test ! expr         # Logical NOT
test e1 -a e2       # Logical AND
test e1 -o e2       # Logical OR

# [ is alias for test (requires ] at end)
[ -f file ]
[ "$a" = "$b" ]
```

### Information Commands

#### type/which/command

```bash
type ls             # Describe command
type -t ls          # Just type (file, builtin, etc.)
which ls            # Path to command
command -v ls       # Path or empty
command ls          # Run command, skip functions/aliases
```

#### help

```bash
help                # List builtins
help cd             # Help for specific builtin
```

### Miscellaneous

#### alias/unalias

```bash
alias ll='ls -la'   # Create alias
alias               # List aliases
unalias ll          # Remove alias
unalias -a          # Remove all
```

#### read

```bash
read var            # Read line into var
read -p "Prompt: " var  # With prompt
read -s var         # Silent (for passwords)
read -n 1 var       # Read single char
read -t 5 var       # Timeout 5 seconds
read -a arr         # Read into array
read v1 v2 v3       # Multiple variables
```

#### shift

```bash
shift               # Shift by 1
shift 2             # Shift by 2
```

#### trap

```bash
trap 'cleanup' EXIT      # Run on exit
trap 'handler' INT       # On Ctrl-C
trap 'handler' TERM      # On termination
trap '' INT              # Ignore signal
trap - INT               # Reset to default
```

#### getopts

```bash
while getopts "ab:c" opt; do
    case $opt in
        a) echo "Option a";;
        b) echo "Option b: $OPTARG";;
        c) echo "Option c";;
        ?) echo "Invalid option";;
    esac
done
shift $((OPTIND-1))
```

#### umask

```bash
umask               # Show current mask
umask 022           # Set mask
```

#### let

```bash
let x=1+2           # Arithmetic
let x++             # Increment
let x+=5            # Add and assign
```

#### history

```bash
history             # Show history
history -c          # Clear history
```

---

## Variable Expansion

### Basic Expansion

```bash
$var                # Value of var
${var}              # Same, with delimiters
"$var"              # Value in double quotes
'$var'              # Literal $var (no expansion)
```

### Default Values

```bash
${var:-default}     # Use default if unset or empty
${var:=default}     # Assign default if unset or empty
${var:+alternate}   # Use alternate if set and non-empty
${var:?error msg}   # Error if unset or empty
${var-default}      # Use default if unset (not empty)
${var=default}      # Assign default if unset
${var+alternate}    # Use alternate if set
${var?error msg}    # Error if unset
```

### String Operations

```bash
${#var}             # Length of string
${var%pattern}      # Remove shortest suffix
${var%%pattern}     # Remove longest suffix
${var#pattern}      # Remove shortest prefix
${var##pattern}     # Remove longest prefix
${var/pat/repl}     # Replace first match
${var//pat/repl}    # Replace all matches
${var/#pat/repl}    # Replace prefix
${var/%pat/repl}    # Replace suffix
${var:offset}       # Substring from offset
${var:offset:len}   # Substring with length
${var^}             # Uppercase first char
${var^^}            # Uppercase all
${var,}             # Lowercase first char
${var,,}            # Lowercase all
```

### Array Operations

```bash
${arr[0]}           # First element
${arr[@]}           # All elements
${arr[*]}           # All as single word
${#arr[@]}          # Number of elements
${!arr[@]}          # All indices
${arr[@]:1:2}       # Slice from index 1, length 2
```

### Special Variables

```bash
$0                  # Script name
$1, $2, ...         # Positional parameters
$#                  # Number of parameters
$@                  # All parameters (separate words)
$*                  # All parameters (single word)
$?                  # Last exit status
$$                  # Current shell PID
$!                  # Last background PID
$-                  # Current options
$_                  # Last argument of previous command
```

---

## Control Flow

### If Statement

```bash
if condition; then
    commands
elif condition; then
    commands
else
    commands
fi

# One-line
if [ -f file ]; then echo "exists"; fi

# With test
if test -f file; then echo "exists"; fi

# With command
if grep -q pattern file; then echo "found"; fi
```

### For Loop

```bash
# List iteration
for item in list of items; do
    echo $item
done

# Range
for i in {1..10}; do echo $i; done

# C-style
for ((i=0; i<10; i++)); do
    echo $i
done

# Files
for file in *.txt; do
    process "$file"
done
```

### While/Until Loops

```bash
# While
while condition; do
    commands
done

# Until (opposite of while)
until condition; do
    commands
done

# Read lines
while read line; do
    echo "$line"
done < file.txt

# Infinite
while true; do
    # ...
    sleep 1
done
```

### Case Statement

```bash
case "$var" in
    pattern1)
        commands
        ;;
    pattern2|pattern3)
        commands
        ;;
    *)
        default commands
        ;;
esac

# Patterns
case "$file" in
    *.txt) echo "text";;
    *.sh)  echo "script";;
    [0-9]*) echo "starts with digit";;
    *)     echo "other";;
esac
```

### Select Statement

```bash
select choice in option1 option2 option3; do
    echo "You chose: $choice"
    break
done
```

### Functions

```bash
# Traditional syntax
function name {
    commands
    return 0
}

# POSIX syntax
name() {
    commands
}

# jsh: Named parameters
greet(name, greeting) {
    echo "$greeting, $name!"
}

# jsh: fn shorthand
fn helper {
    echo "helper function"
}

# Call function
name arg1 arg2

# Access arguments
function show {
    echo "First: $1"
    echo "Second: $2"
    echo "All: $@"
    echo "Count: $#"
}
```

---

## jsh Enhanced Syntax

### Match Expression

Pattern matching similar to Rust's match:

```bash
match $value {
    # Literal match
    "hello" => echo "greeting"

    # Multiple patterns (OR)
    1 | 2 | 3 => echo "small number"

    # Range (numeric)
    10..20 => echo "between 10 and 20"

    # Regex pattern
    /^[A-Z]/ => echo "starts with uppercase"

    # Wildcard (default)
    * => echo "anything else"
}

# With commands
match $status {
    0 => {
        echo "Success"
        log_success
    }
    1 => echo "General error"
    * => {
        echo "Unknown error: $status"
        exit 1
    }
}
```

### Try/Catch/Finally

Structured error handling:

```bash
try {
    # Commands that might fail
    risky_command
    another_risky_command
} catch err {
    # Handle error (err contains message)
    echo "Error occurred: $err"
    log_error "$err"
} finally {
    # Always runs (cleanup)
    cleanup_resources
}

# Without finally
try {
    cmd
} catch e {
    echo "Failed: $e"
}

# Nested
try {
    try {
        inner_risky
    } catch e {
        echo "Inner failed"
        raise_error
    }
} catch e {
    echo "Outer caught: $e"
}
```

### Named Function Parameters

Functions with named parameters:

```bash
# Basic named parameters
greet(name, greeting) {
    echo "$greeting, $name!"
}
greet "World" "Hello"  # Output: Hello, World!

# Parameters are also positional
show(first, second) {
    echo "Named: first=$first second=$second"
    echo "Positional: \$1=$1 \$2=$2"
}

# Works with all function syntaxes
fn add(a, b) {
    echo $((a + b))
}

function multiply(x, y) {
    echo $((x * y))
}

# Default values (use expansion)
greet(name, greeting) {
    name=${name:-"Guest"}
    greeting=${greeting:-"Hello"}
    echo "$greeting, $name!"
}
```

### Let/Const Bindings

Variable bindings with mutability control:

```bash
# Mutable binding
let counter = 0
let counter = $((counter + 1))  # Can reassign

# Immutable binding
const PI = "3.14159"
const VERSION = "1.0.0"
# const PI = "3.0"  # Error: cannot reassign const

# In expressions
let result = $(calculate)
const CONFIG = $(cat config.json)
```

### Loop Statement

Infinite loop with break/continue:

```bash
loop {
    read -p "Command: " cmd

    # Exit condition
    [ "$cmd" = "quit" ] && break

    # Skip condition
    [ -z "$cmd" ] && continue

    # Execute command
    eval "$cmd"
}

# With counter
let i = 0
loop {
    let i = $((i + 1))
    echo "Iteration $i"
    [ $i -ge 10 ] && break
}
```

### Fn Shorthand

Short function definition syntax:

```bash
fn greet {
    echo "Hello, $1!"
}

fn process {
    cat "$1" | sort | uniq
}

# With named parameters
fn add(a, b) {
    echo $((a + b))
}
```

---

## Fish Compatibility

### Set Command

```bash
# Set variable
set name "value"
set path "/usr/local/bin"

# Export (add to environment)
set -x PATH "/usr/local/bin" $PATH
set -x EDITOR "vim"

# Erase variable
set -e name

# Query (check if set)
set -q name && echo "name is set"

# Global scope
set -g global_var "value"

# Multiple values (array-like)
set fruits apple banana cherry
echo $fruits[1]  # apple
```

### String Builtin

```bash
# Length
string length "hello"           # 5

# Case conversion
string upper "hello"            # HELLO
string lower "HELLO"            # hello

# Split
string split "," "a,b,c"        # a\nb\nc
string split "" "hello"         # h\ne\nl\nl\no

# Join
string join "-" a b c           # a-b-c
string join ", " $items

# Replace
string replace "old" "new" "old text"
string replace -a "o" "0" "foo"  # f00 (all)
string replace -r "^h" "H" "hello"  # Regex

# Match
string match "*.txt" "file.txt"
string match -r "[0-9]+" "abc123def"

# Substring
string sub -s 1 -l 3 "hello"    # hel
string sub -s 2 "hello"         # ello

# Trim
string trim "  hello  "         # hello
string trim -l "  hello"        # "hello"
string trim -r "hello  "        # "hello"
```

### Math Builtin

```bash
# Basic arithmetic
math "2 + 3"          # 5
math "10 - 3"         # 7
math "4 * 5"          # 20
math "20 / 4"         # 5
math "17 % 5"         # 2

# Exponents
math "2 ^ 10"         # 1024
math "2 ** 8"         # 256

# Functions
math "sqrt(16)"       # 4
math "abs(-5)"        # 5
math "sin(3.14159)"   # ~0
math "cos(0)"         # 1
math "log(100)"       # ~4.6
math "floor(3.7)"     # 3
math "ceil(3.2)"      # 4
math "round(3.5)"     # 4

# Comparison (returns 0 or 1)
math "5 > 3"          # 1
math "2 == 2"         # 1
```

### Contains Builtin

```bash
set fruits apple banana cherry

# Check membership
contains apple $fruits && echo "Found apple"
contains grape $fruits || echo "No grape"

# In conditions
if contains "$item" $list; then
    echo "Item is in list"
fi
```

### Status Builtin

```bash
# Check shell state
status is-interactive && echo "Interactive"
status is-login && echo "Login shell"
status is-command-substitution
status is-block
status is-breakpoint

# Get information
status --current-filename
status --current-line-number
status --current-function
```

### Functions Builtin

```bash
# List all functions
functions

# Query if function exists
functions -q myfunction && echo "Exists"

# Erase function
functions -e myfunction

# Get function definition
functions myfunction
```

### Abbreviations

```bash
# Add abbreviation
abbr --add gc "git commit"
abbr --add gp "git push"
abbr --add ll "ls -la"

# List abbreviations
abbr --list
abbr

# Erase abbreviation
abbr --erase gc
```

### Switch/Case/End

```bash
switch $command
    case start
        echo "Starting service..."
        start_service
    case stop
        echo "Stopping service..."
        stop_service
    case restart
        echo "Restarting..."
        stop_service
        start_service
    case status
        check_status
    case '*'
        echo "Unknown command: $command"
        echo "Usage: $0 {start|stop|restart|status}"
end
```

### Begin/End Blocks

```bash
begin
    set local_var "value"
    process_something
    echo $local_var
end

# Variables inside begin/end are scoped
```

### And/Or/Not

```bash
# Logical operators
test -f file
and echo "File exists"
or echo "File missing"

# Chain commands
cmd1
and cmd2
and cmd3

# Negation
not test -f file && echo "File missing"
```

---

## Git Integration

### in_git_repo

Check if current directory is in a git repository:

```bash
if in_git_repo; then
    echo "Inside a git repository"
else
    echo "Not in a git repo"
fi

# Use in conditions
in_git_repo && git_branch
```

### git_branch

Get the current branch name:

```bash
# Simple usage
git_branch                    # main

# In command substitution
echo "Branch: $(git_branch)"

# In conditions
if [ "$(git_branch)" = "main" ]; then
    echo "On main branch!"
fi
```

### git_status

Check repository status:

```bash
# Print status summary
git_status

# Check for uncommitted changes
git_status --dirty && echo "Has uncommitted changes"

# Check for staged changes
git_status --staged && echo "Has staged changes"

# Check if clean
git_status --clean && echo "Working tree is clean"

# Use in deployment scripts
if git_status --dirty; then
    echo "Error: Uncommitted changes"
    exit 1
fi
```

### git_info

Get detailed git repository information:

```bash
# All information
git_info

# Query specific fields
git_info --query branch       # Branch name
git_info --query hash         # Full commit hash
git_info --query short-hash   # Short hash (7 chars)
git_info --query remote       # Remote name (origin)
git_info --query upstream     # Upstream branch
git_info --query ahead        # Commits ahead of upstream
git_info --query behind       # Commits behind upstream
git_info --query stash        # Stash count
git_info --query tag          # Current tag

# Custom format
git_info --format '%b'        # Just branch
git_info --format '%b (%h)'   # "main (abc1234)"
git_info --format '%b +%a -%z'  # "main +2 -1"

# Format specifiers
# %b - branch name
# %h - short hash
# %H - full hash
# %r - remote
# %u - upstream
# %a - ahead count
# %z - behind count
# %s - stash count
# %t - tag
# %d - dirty indicator (✗ if dirty)
# %c - staged indicator (● if staged)
```

### git_prompt

Git information formatted for shell prompts:

```bash
# Default format
git_prompt                    # (main)

# Custom format
git_prompt -f ' [%b%d]'       # [main✗]
git_prompt -f ' %b%d%c'       # main✗●

# In PS1
PS1='\u@\h:\w$(git_prompt)$ '
PS1='\w$(git_prompt -f " [%b%d]")$ '

# Only if in repo
PS1='\w$(in_git_repo && git_prompt -f " (%b)")$ '
```

### Example: Complete Git Prompt

```bash
# ~/.jshrc
git_prompt_custom() {
    if ! in_git_repo; then
        return
    fi

    local branch=$(git_branch)
    local dirty=""
    local staged=""

    git_status --dirty && dirty="✗"
    git_status --staged && staged="●"

    echo " ($branch$dirty$staged)"
}

PS1='\[\033[01;32m\]\u@\h\[\033[00m\]:\[\033[01;34m\]\w\[\033[33m\]$(git_prompt_custom)\[\033[00m\]$ '
```

---

## Themes and Prompts

### Theme System

jsh includes an oh-my-zsh compatible theme system:

```bash
# Set theme in .jshrc
export JSH_THEME="robbyrussell"

# Set theme interactively
theme robbyrussell
theme set agnoster

# List available themes
theme list

# Preview themes
theme preview
```

### Built-in Themes

| Theme | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| jsh | Default two-line with git |
| robbyrussell | Classic oh-my-zsh default |
| agnoster | Powerline-style segments |
| minimal | Clean and simple |
| powerlevel | Powerline with time |
| simple | Basic user@host:path$ |
| pure | Inspired by ZSH Pure |

### Prompt Escape Sequences

| Sequence | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `%n` | Username |
| `%m` | Short hostname |
| `%M` | Full hostname |
| `%~` | Current directory (~ for home) |
| `%c` / `%1~` | Current directory name only |
| `%/` | Full path |
| `%T` | Time (HH:MM) |
| `%*` | Time (HH:MM:SS) |
| `%D{format}` | Custom date format |
| `%?` | Last exit status |
| `%#` | `#` for root, `%` for user |
| `%!` | History number |
| `%%` | Literal % |

### Colors

| Sequence | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `%F{color}` | Start foreground color |
| `%f` | End foreground color |
| `%K{color}` | Start background color |
| `%k` | End background color |
| `%B` | Start bold |
| `%b` | End bold |
| `%U` | Start underline |
| `%u` | End underline |

#### Color Names

- Basic: black, red, green, yellow, blue, magenta, cyan, white
- Bright: bright_red, bright_green, etc.
- 256-color: 0-255
- True color: #ff5500

### Conditional Prompts

```bash
# Based on exit status
%(?.success.failure)
%(?.%F{green}✓.%F{red}✗)%f

# Based on UID
%(!.#.$)  # # for root, $ otherwise
```

### Custom Prompt Examples

```bash
# Simple
export PROMPT='%n@%m:%~$ '

# With colors
export PROMPT='%F{cyan}%n%f@%F{blue}%m%f:%F{yellow}%~%f$ '

# Two-line with git
export PROMPT='%F{green}%n@%m%f %F{blue}%~%f $(git_prompt_info)
%F{yellow}❯%f '

# With right prompt
export RPROMPT='%F{8}%T%f'

# With exit status indicator
export PROMPT='%(?.%F{green}✓.%F{red}✗)%f %~ $ '
```

---

## Configuration

### Configuration File Locations

#### All Shells (sourced for every invocation)

1. `/etc/jshenv` - System-wide environment
2. `~/.jshenv` - User environment
3. `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/jsh/env` - XDG location

#### Login Shells (add to above)

1. `/etc/environment` - System environment (KEY=VALUE)
2. `/etc/profile` - System profile
3. `/etc/profile.d/*.sh` - Additional system scripts
4. `/etc/jsh_profile` - jsh-specific system profile
5. `~/.jsh_profile` OR `~/.bash_profile` OR `~/.bash_login` OR `~/.profile`

#### Interactive Shells (add to all shells)

1. `/etc/jshrc` OR `/etc/jsh.jshrc` OR `/etc/bash.bashrc`
2. `~/.jshrc` OR `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/jsh/jshrc` OR `~/.bashrc` OR `~/.zshrc`

### Example ~/.jshenv

```bash
# ~/.jshenv - Sourced for ALL shells including non-interactive scripts

# Path modifications
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/bin:$PATH"
export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH"

# Editor and tools
export EDITOR="vim"
export VISUAL="vim"
export PAGER="less"

# Language
export LANG="en_US.UTF-8"
export LC_ALL="en_US.UTF-8"

# Application settings
export CARGO_HOME="$HOME/.cargo"
export RUSTUP_HOME="$HOME/.rustup"
export GOPATH="$HOME/go"

# Less options
export LESS="-R"
export LESSHISTFILE=-
```

### Example ~/.jshrc

```bash
# ~/.jshrc - Interactive shell configuration

# Theme
export JSH_THEME="robbyrussell"

# Aliases - Navigation
alias ..='cd ..'
alias ...='cd ../..'
alias ~='cd ~'
alias -- -='cd -'

# Aliases - Listing
alias ls='ls --color=auto'
alias ll='ls -la'
alias la='ls -A'
alias l='ls -CF'

# Aliases - Safety
alias rm='rm -i'
alias cp='cp -i'
alias mv='mv -i'

# Aliases - Git
alias g='git'
alias ga='git add'
alias gc='git commit'
alias gp='git push'
alias gl='git pull'
alias gs='git status'
alias gd='git diff'
alias gb='git branch'
alias gco='git checkout'

# Functions
mkcd() {
    mkdir -p "$1" && cd "$1"
}

# jsh functions with named parameters
greet(name) {
    echo "Hello, ${name:-World}!"
}

# Extract any archive
extract(file) {
    match ${file##*.} {
        "tar" | "tgz" | "tbz2" | "txz" => tar xf "$file"
        "gz" => gunzip "$file"
        "bz2" => bunzip2 "$file"
        "zip" => unzip "$file"
        "rar" => unrar x "$file"
        "7z" => 7z x "$file"
        * => echo "Unknown archive format"
    }
}

# Custom prompt with git
PS1='\[\033[01;32m\]\u@\h\[\033[00m\]:\[\033[01;34m\]\w\[\033[33m\]$(git_prompt -f " [%b%d]")\[\033[00m\]$ '

# Key bindings (if supported)
# bind '"\e[A": history-search-backward'
# bind '"\e[B": history-search-forward'

# Startup message
echo "Welcome to jsh!"
```

### Example ~/.jsh_profile

```bash
# ~/.jsh_profile - Login shell initialization (sourced once at login)

# Source environment first
[ -f ~/.jshenv ] && source ~/.jshenv

# Start SSH agent if not running
if [ -z "$SSH_AUTH_SOCK" ]; then
    eval $(ssh-agent -s) > /dev/null
fi

# Load secrets
[ -f ~/.secrets ] && source ~/.secrets

# Load any work-specific config
[ -f ~/.jsh_profile.work ] && source ~/.jsh_profile.work

# Welcome
echo "Welcome back, $USER!"
date
echo ""

# Source interactive config
[ -f ~/.jshrc ] && source ~/.jshrc
```

## Shell Options

### Set Options (Bash/POSIX Compatible)

| Short | Long | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `-e` | `errexit` | Exit immediately if command fails |
| `-u` | `nounset` | Treat unset variables as error |
| `-x` | `xtrace` | Print commands before execution |
| `-n` | `noexec` | Parse but don't execute |
| `-a` | `allexport` | Export all variables automatically |
| `-C` | `noclobber` | Don't overwrite files with > |
| `-b` | `notify` | Notify immediately when jobs complete |
| `-f` | `noglob` | Disable filename globbing |

### Additional Options

| Option | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `vi` | Vi editing mode |
| `emacs` | Emacs editing mode (default) |
| `ignoreeof` | Don't exit on Ctrl-D |
| `posix` | POSIX compatibility mode |

### Setting Options

```bash
# Enable with -
set -e                  # Short form
set -o errexit          # Long form

# Disable with +
set +e
set +o errexit

# Multiple options
set -eux

# Check option status
set -o                  # Show all options

# In scripts (recommended at top)
#!/usr/bin/env jsh
set -euo pipefail

# jsh also supports ShellOptions struct internally
# options.errexit, options.nounset, etc.
```

---

## Examples

### Complete Script Examples

#### Deployment Script

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env jsh
set -euo pipefail

const VERSION = "$1"
const ENV = "${2:-production}"

deploy(version, environment) {
    echo "Deploying $version to $environment..."

    # Check for clean working tree
    if in_git_repo && git_status --dirty; then
        echo "Error: Working tree is dirty"
        exit 1
    fi

    # Verify branch
    match $(git_branch) {
        "main" | "master" => echo "Deploying from main branch"
        "develop" => {
            if [ "$environment" = "production" ]; then
                echo "Error: Cannot deploy develop to production"
                exit 1
            fi
        }
        * => {
            echo "Warning: Deploying from feature branch"
        }
    }

    try {
        # Run deployment
        ./scripts/deploy.sh "$version" "$environment"
    } catch err {
        echo "Deployment failed: $err"
        ./scripts/rollback.sh
        exit 1
    } finally {
        # Notify regardless of outcome
        ./scripts/notify.sh "$version" "$environment"
    }
}

deploy "$VERSION" "$ENV"
```

#### Configuration Parser

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env jsh

parse_config(file) {
    if ! [ -f "$file" ]; then
        echo "Config file not found: $file"
        return 1
    fi

    while read line; do
        # Skip comments and empty lines
        match $line {
            "#*" | "" => continue
            *"="* => {
                # Parse key=value
                local key=${line%%=*}
                local value=${line#*=}

                # Remove quotes
                value=$(string trim "$value")
                value=${value#\"}
                value=${value%\"}

                # Export
                export "$key=$value"
            }
            * => echo "Warning: Invalid line: $line"
        }
    done < "$file"
}

# Usage
parse_config "app.conf"
echo "DATABASE: $DATABASE"
echo "PORT: $PORT"
```

#### File Processor with Fish-style

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env jsh

set files (find . -name "*.txt")

for file in $files
    set content (cat "$file")
    set lines (string split "\n" "$content")
    set count (math "${#lines[@]}")

    echo "$file: $count lines"

    if contains "TODO" $content
        echo "  → Contains TODO items"
    end
end
```

#### Interactive Menu

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env jsh

show_menu() {
    echo "=== Main Menu ==="
    echo "1. List files"
    echo "2. Show date"
    echo "3. System info"
    echo "4. Git status"
    echo "q. Quit"
}

loop {
    show_menu
    read -p "Choice: " choice

    match $choice {
        "1" => ls -la
        "2" => date
        "3" => uname -a
        "4" => {
            if in_git_repo; then
                echo "Branch: $(git_branch)"
                git_status
            else
                echo "Not in a git repository"
            fi
        }
        "q" | "Q" => {
            echo "Goodbye!"
            break
        }
        * => echo "Invalid choice"
    }

    echo ""
    read -p "Press Enter to continue..."
}
```

### File Structure

```
jsh/
├── src/
│   ├── main.rs          # CLI entry point
│   ├── lib.rs           # Library exports
│   ├── lexer.rs         # Tokenization
│   ├── parser.rs        # AST construction
│   ├── ast.rs           # AST nodes
│   ├── interpreter.rs   # Execution engine
│   ├── builtins.rs      # Built-in commands
│   ├── shell.rs         # REPL/interactive
│   ├── theme.rs         # Prompt themes
│   ├── error.rs         # Error types
│   ├── token.rs         # Token definitions
│   └── argparse.rs      # Argument parser
├── docs/                # Documentation site
├── benches/             # Benchmarks
├── packaging/           # Distribution packages
├── examples/            # Example scripts
└── tests/               # Integration tests
```
